note: Half a version left on disk.

note: Nothing to roll back to.

name: DA13-26-the-ready-version-never-played

name: DA13-36-the-boot-never-says
note: The game never says it came up.

name: DA13-37-any-url
note: The channel fetches whatever a release JSON names.

name: DA13-39-a-game-ahead-asks-the-installer

note: A version the channel already brought is fetched again and again.

name: DA13-41-switched-under-a-running-page
note: A running page's lazy chunks swapped from under it.

name: DA13-42-a-200-read-whole
note: A host that ignores Range is read whole - the full pack - before it is refused.

name: DA13-43-the-release-without-its-game
note: A release with no game published: every copy takes the installer.

name: DA13-44-the-ceiling-lifted
note: A DA11-sized regression publishes.

name: DA13-45-a-moved-id-passes
note: A shell id that moves with nothing changed sends every update to the installer, unseen.

name: DA13-46-the-icon-not-the-shell
note: A file the shell packs from outside app/ changes nothing in its id.

name: DA13-47-the-game-in-the-shell-id
note: Every release changes the shell's id: the installer every time.

name: DA13-49-a-pack-per-leg
note: Three packs, one name - the last leg's wins over the manifest of another.

name: DA13-50-not-measured
note: A regressed update publishes.

name: DA13-51-the-seed-not-packed
note: electron-builder leaves the index out of the shell.

name: DA13-52-a-cancelled-navigation-switches
note: A navigation the fence cancels switches the ready version under the page still running, and the next launch rolls it back.

name: DA13-53-a-same-document-step-switches
note: A hash or history step keeps the page, and the version switches under it.

note: A frame inside the page navigates, and the version switches under the page.
